questions.question: Rishabh is a 10 year old boy. If his mother is 20 years older than him and 6 years younger than his father, then what is his father's age?
questions.solution:
Age of Rishabh = 10 years

If his mother is 20 years older than him.

So, age of his mother = (10 + 20) years

= 30 years

If his mother is 6 years younger than his father.

Age of his father = (30 + 6) years

= 36 years

Hence, ’36 years’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

9 : 121 :: 7 : ?
questions.solution:
The logic is:

9 : 121 → 9 : (9 + 2)²

Similarly,

7 : ? → 7 : (7 + 2)²

=> ? = 9²

=> ? = 81

Hence, ‘81’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(2, 6, 32)
questions.solution:
The logic is:

**(2nd number - 1st number) × 8 = 3rd number**

(2, 6, 32) → (6 – 2) × 8 = 32

Similarly,

**(8, 18, 80) → (18 – 8) × 8 = 80**

Hence, ‘(8, 18, 80)’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Arrange the following words in a logical and meaningful order.

1. Letter

2. Satellite

3. Telephone

4. Smartphone
questions.solution:
Words are arranged in the order of their technological advantages.

**1. Letter -** By letter, we can send information to someone. 

**3. Telephone -** We can call to someone. 

**4. Smartphone -** We can voice call, video call, and text messages to one person/more than one person.

**2. Satellite -** It is used in a wide variety of applications such as global mobile communication, private business networks, Long distance telephone transmission, weather forecasting, radio/TV signal broadcasting, connecting remote areas, television distribution etc.

Hence, ‘1, 3, 4, 2’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: A and B can do a piece of work in 30 days and 18 days respectively. A started the work alone and then after 6 days B joined him till the completion of the work. In how many days has the whole work completed?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da83afca039254e1696b7631ca0cb5764fab6db31c114802b700030e85145c90.png] 

Total work is 90 units.

A worked for 6 days and efficiency of A is 3.

So, total work done by A in 6 days = (6 × 3)

= 18 units

Remaining work = (90 – 18) units

= 72 units

Efficiency of A and B is 3 and 5 respectively.

So, together they will complete the remaining work in [72 ÷ (3 + 5)] days

= [72 ÷ 8] days

= 9 days

 [IMAGE: file:///C:/Users/JAYESH/AppData/Local/Temp/msohtmlclip1/01/clip_image002.png] Number of days in which the whole work was completed = (6 + 9) days

= 15 days

Hence, ‘15’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which two signs and numbers should be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

16 × 18 + 2 - 14 ÷ 3 = 38
questions.solution:
1) 14 and 18, + and –

Given expression: 16 × 18 + 2 - 14 ÷ 3 = 38

After replacing the numbers and symbols, we get:

16 × 14 – 2 + 18 ÷ 3 = 38

=> 224 – 2 + 6 = 38

=> 230 – 2 = 38

=> 228 ≠ 38

2) 14 and 18, + and ×

Given expression: 16 × 18 + 2 - 14 ÷ 3 = 38

After replacing the numbers and symbols, we get:

16 + 14 × 2 - 18 ÷ 3 = 38

=> 16 + 28 – 6 = 38

=> 44 – 6 = 38

=> 38 = 38

3) 16 and 3, - and ÷

Given expression: 16 × 18 + 2 - 14 ÷ 3 = 38

After replacing the numbers and symbols, we get:

3 × 18 + 2 ÷ 14 - 16 = 38

=> 54 + 0.14 – 16 = 38

=> 54.15 – 16 = 38

=> 38.15 ≠ 38

4) 16 and 14, - and ×

Given expression: 16 × 18 + 2 - 14 ÷ 3 = 38

After replacing the numbers and symbols, we get:

14 - 18 + 2 × 16 ÷ 3 = 38

=> 14 – 18 + 10.67 = 38

=> 24.67 – 18 = 38

=> 6.67 ≠ 38

 Hence, ‘14 and 18, + and ×’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. All doors are teachers.

2. All teachers are cups.

**Conclusions:**

I. All cups are doors.

II. All doors are cups.

III. All teachers are doors.

IV. Some cups are teachers.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow.
Only conclusions II and IV follow.
Only conclusions I and III follow.

questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/348f982b0f11da79622a28648c7ff0060dd4610e466d7b8200b60c592ba2a0d8.png] 

Concept:

1) We have to check the conclusions are 100% match with the statement. If the conclusion is 100% match with the given statement then the conclusion is true. If there is a 1% chance of not following the statement then the conclusion is considered to be false.

2) The possibility case can be considered to be "false" in "definite case".

3) In Possibility case, either "can" or "possible" word must be present.

__Explanation__

The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eacfa5fe2f0d6270213bf3d898ea6ede068372aaee769cc7b2ee037fef5bc6f2.png] 

I. All cups are doors. → False (It can be possible but it is not definite)

II. All doors are cups. → True (It is definite)

III. All teachers are doors. → False (It can be possible but it is not definite)

IV. Some cups are teachers. → True (It is definite)

Hence, only conclusions II and IV follow.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__
